clues: I tried to run away from what God asked me to do.
I boarded a ship heading the opposite direction.
A great storm arose because of me.
I spent three days and nights inside a great fish.
I was not born an Israelite.
I refused to leave my mother-in-law's side.
I gleaned grain in the fields of Bethlehem.
I married a man named Boaz.
I became an ancestor of King David.
